subject: Renewal: Aurora Tech — pricing & commit revision
messages:
From: Maya Singh <maya@aurora.tech>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Carlos Ortega <carlos.ortega@procurecorp.com>
Date: 2026-09-23T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal discussion — draft numbers and procurement timeline

Hi Naomi / Marissa,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. Procurement asked us to capture a couple of scenarios so they can run internal approvals:
- Option A: 12-month renewal, 20% commit increase, 12% list-rate discount, no onboarding credit
- Option B: 24-month renewal, flat commit (no increase), 18% list-rate discount, $50k onboarding credit (applied in first invoice)

We need final terms to route to Finance by next Wednesday (Sep 30). Also flagged the need for a firm price hold through end of Q1 2027 while we finish implementation.

Attached is the procurement checklist they requested (procure-checklist.pdf).

Best,
Maya
Maya Singh
Head of Cloud Engineering, Aurora Tech

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Maya Singh <maya@aurora.tech>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-23T10:06:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal discussion — draft numbers and procurement timeline

Maya — thanks for the clear scenarios and the timeline.

Quick thoughts:
- We can hold pricing through 2027-03-31 for either option if procurement signs before Oct 15.  That aligns with the price-hold window your team requested.
- For Option A (12m / +20%): we can offer a blended discount of 13% and a $25k onboarding credit tied to completion of the onboarding SOW within 90 days.
- For Option B (24m / flat): we can stretch to 19% and $60k onboarding credit, but we need a 10% payment-on-sign milestone (or equivalent invoice schedule) up front to secure that uplift.

Looping in Marissa and Ben for approval on the credit math and whether we should ask for a modest commit increase instead of the payment milestone. Marissa — can you confirm whether the $60k onboarding credit with a 10% milestone is approvable from a margin perspective? Ben — any commercial constraints you see?

I'll consolidate and send a single redline to procurement once we have alignment.

Thanks,
Naomi
Sr. Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-24T11:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal discussion — draft numbers and procurement timeline

Folks — ran the numbers with Finance. Summary (high level):
- Option A (12 months, +20% commit): Approved discount 15% list, onboarding credit $30,000, price hold through 2027-03-31 if signed by Oct 15. Require written commit amendment (min monthly commit +20% over current run rate).
- Option B (24 months, flat commit): Approved discount 18% list, onboarding credit $60,000, price hold through 2027-06-30 if signed by Oct 15 (we can extend the hold for multi-year). Require 10% upfront invoice or signed multi-year PO.

Trade-offs and recommendation: Aim for Option B if Aurora can accept the 10% milestone or a multi-year PO — it protects our unit economics longer and we can absorb the higher onboarding credit. If Aurora prefers no upfront milestone, Option A with the commit uplift + $30k credit is cleaner and keeps cash impact lower.

I've attached a short pricing-summary.xlsx with blended ARR, gross margin impact, and the redline we should send to procurement (Aurora_Renewal_V3_redline.pdf).

Next steps for Naomi:
- Confirm which option procurement prefers and whether they can commit to the Oct 15 signed-by date.
- If Option B, ask for the invoicing milestone language or multi-year PO.

Marissa
Head of Sales Operations, Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-25T09:49:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal discussion — draft numbers and procurement timeline

Naomi / Marissa — I agree with Marissa's framing. A couple of guardrails:
- Approve the $60k onboarding credit for multi-year only. For 12m (Option A), cap credits to $30k and tie to onboarding SOW deliverables (acceptance sign-off).
- If Aurora will not do the 10% upfront milestone, offer a banked-credit structure: $60k credit for 24m but amortized as $5k/month credit applied against invoices if they hit usage milestones (>= 90% of committed throughput). That preserves cash flow and incentivizes adoption.
- We should also include a clause that allows a 6-month review if usage materially under-indexes to commit (>30% below run rate) so we can re-open pricing.

If those are acceptable, I'm happy to rubber-stamp and ask Legal to fast-track the redline.

-Ben
VP Sales, Redwood Inference

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Maya Singh <maya@aurora.tech>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Carlos Ortega <carlos.ortega@procurecorp.com>
Date: 2026-09-27T15:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal discussion — draft numbers and procurement timeline

Maya / Carlos — thanks for the quick turnaround and for being flexible. Based on internal alignment, here is a single path we think will clear procurement and Legal quickly:

Agreed commercial path (preferred):
- 24-month term (Oct 2026 — Sep 2028)
- Flat commit (no immediate increase)
- 18% list-rate discount
- $60,000 onboarding credit applied as banked credit, amortized at $5k/month and applied to invoices contingent on meeting usage milestones (>=90% of committed throughput)
- 10% invoice on-sign OR signed multi-year PO (accept either to secure the higher credit)
- Price hold: firm through 2027-06-30 if signed by Oct 15; if we get a signed multi-year PO instead of upfront invoice, extend price hold through 2027-12-31.
- Legal redlines: we've attached Aurora_Renewal_V3_redline.pdf. Please review and revert with any specific legal exceptions; otherwise, I'll ask our Legal to start the DocuSign asap.

If procurement prefers the 12-month, +20% commit path, we can do: 12 months / +20% commit / 15% discount / $30k onboarding credit / price hold through 2027-03-31 (signed by Oct 15).

Next steps:
1) Please confirm preferred option by EOD Fri Sep 30 so we can get Legal and Finance into DocuSign flow.
2) If you confirm the 24m path, send either the 10% on-sign PO or indicate you'll provide the multi-year PO and we will adapt the final DocuSign accordingly.

Forwarding the redline now; procurement checklist remains attached. HubSpot deal DL-9482-AUR will be updated once we have your confirmation.

Thanks,
Naomi
Sr. Account Executive, Redwood Inference
